item.title: New Way to Build Cloud-Native Applications with .NET 8 Aspire
item.description:

However, for many .NET developers, the journey to creating fully cloud-native applications has traditionally been fraught with complexity and challenges.

item.title: Top 5 Steps to Programmatically Control `<body>` Tag in Blazor WASM
item.description:
In Blazor WebAssembly (WASM), you might find yourself needing to control the <body> tag of your application, especially when integrating with custom HTML templates or themes. While the <body> tag is outside the Blazor DOM scope, you can still programmatically manipulate it using JavaScript Interoperability (JS Interop). This post covers the top 5 steps to manage and manipulate the <body> tag in Blazor WASM.

Step 1: Understand the Limitations of Blazor’s DOM Scope

Blazor WASM operates within a specific DOM scope, meaning certain elements, like the <body> tag, are not directly accessible. To manipulate the <body> tag, you must use JS Interop to bridge the gap between Blazor and the broader HTML document.

item.title: Top 5 Steps to Fix CSS Issues in Blazor .NET 8 Preview 6

Whether you’re dealing with misconfigured paths or conflicts with Razor components, this guide has got you covered.

1. Understanding the Root Cause

The first step to solving CSS issues in Blazor .NET 8 Preview 6 is identifying the root cause. In many cases, the problem arises from how Blazor handles routing and static file serving. When the route matches a CSS file’s name, Blazor may mistakenly interpret it as a page route, leading to the file not being served correctly.
